verdict.rationale: Granola's docs say it captures Zoom, Google Meet and Teams through computer audio without a bot, prompts you to start transcribing from a calendar notification, and detects when a call ends. That covers the capture core of the story. The evidence describes transcription only: there is nothing on saving audio or video recordings, or on choosing which meetings are recorded beyond starting or stopping manually. Missing for 10: documented audio/video recording and control over where recording happens, plus independent hands-on evidence that capture is reliable across Zoom, Meet and Teams.

support.subject: As a product manager, the notetaker reliably captures Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams meetings, with recording where I want it

citations.quote: Works with Zoom, Google Meet, Teams and every other meeting app.
It can transcribe meetings (Zoom, Meet, Teams, etc.), in-person conversations, voice memos, and any computer audio.
Uses your computer audio, so doesn't invite a bot
Open your Granola note for that meeting, and start transcribing
Once Granola has recognised your call has ended, or you stop it manually, it will automatically generate enhanced notes.
